const express = require("express");
2+
const cors = require("cors");
3+
const bodyParser = require("body-parser");
4+
const { Pool } = require("pg");
5+
6+
const app = express();
7+
app.use(cors());
8+
app.use(bodyParser.json());
9+
10+
// PostgreSQL bağlantı
11+
const pool = new Pool({
12+
user: "postgres",
13+
host: "localhost",
14+
database: "beauty_vlog",
15+
password: "12345"
16+
port: 5432,
17+
});
18+
19+
// REGISTER
20+
app.post("/register", async (req, res) => {
21+
const { name, surname, email, password } = req.body;
22+
23+
try {
24+
await pool.query(
25+
'INSERT INTO "user"(name, surname, email, password) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)', [name, surname, email, password]
26+
);
27+
28+
res.json({ success: true, message: "Qeydiyyat uğurlu" });
29+
} catch (err) {
30+
res.json({ success: false, message: "Email artıq mövcuddur" });
31+
}
32+
});
33+
34+
// ================= LOGIN =================
35+
app.post("/login", async (req, res) => {
36+
const { email, password } = req.body;
37+
38+
const result = await pool.query(
39+
'SELECT * FROM "user" WHERE email=$1 AND password=$2',
40+
[email, password]
41+
);
42+
43+
if (result.rows.length > 0) {
44+
res.json({ success: true });
45+
} else {
46+
res.json({ success: false });
47+
}
48+
});
49+
50+
// ================= CONTACT =================
51+
app.post("/contact", async (req, res) => {
52+
const { email, subscribed } = req.body;
53+
54+
await pool.query(
55+
"INSERT INTO messages(email, subscribed) VALUES ($1,$2)",
56+
[email, subscribed]
57+
);
58+
59+
res.json({ message: "Göndərildi" });
60+
});
61+
62+
app.listen(3000, () => {
63+
console.log("Server işləyir → http://localhost:3000");
64+
